Checking language support on an unregistered OCR backend returns an error, since there is no backend to delegate the check to

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Xberg\Xberg;
try {
    Xberg::ocrBackendSupportsLanguage("nonexistent-backend-xyz", "eng");
} catch (Throwable $error) {
    echo $error::class . ': ' . $error->getMessage() . "\n";
}
```
